    private Integer entryTotalScore;
    @Column(name = "entry_trend_score")
    private Integer entryTrendScore;
    @Column(name = "entry_structure_score")
    private Integer entryStructureScore;
    @Column(name = "entry_momentum_score")
    private Integer entryMomentumScore;
    @Column(name = "entry_volume_score")
    private Integer entryVolumeScore;
    @Column(name = "entry_sentiment_score")
    private Integer entrySentimentScore;
    @Column(name = "entry_fundamental_score")
    private Integer entryFundamentalScore;
    @Column(name = "entry_decision", length = 30)
    private String entryDecision;
    @Column(name = "entry_decision_path_json", columnDefinition = "json")
    private String entryDecisionPathJson;
    @Column(name = "entry_analysis_snapshot_json", columnDefinition = "json")
    private String entryAnalysisSnapshotJson;
    @Column(name = "stop_loss_usdt", precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal stopLossUsdt;
    @Column(name = "take_profit_usdt", precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal takeProfitUsdt;
    @Column(name = "highest_price_usdt", precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal highestPriceUsdt;
    @Column(name = "profit_lock_active", nullable = false)
    private boolean profitLockActive;
    @Column(name = "profit_lock_price_usdt", precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal profitLockPriceUsdt;
    @Column(name = "profit_lock_progress_percent", precision = 12, scale = 6)
    private BigDecimal profitLockProgressPercent;
    @Column(name = "profit_lock_activated_at")
    private Instant profitLockActivatedAt;
    // FIX-118: explicit execution state decouples historically earned protection from
    // whether the old lock is executable after an approved TP extension.
    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "profit_lock_state", nullable = false, length = 40)
    @Builder.Default
    private ProfitLockState profitLockState = ProfitLockState.INACTIVE;

    @Column(name = "allocated_position_percent", nullable = false)
    private int allocatedPositionPercent;
    @Column(name = "entry_quality_score", nullable = false)
    private int entryQualityScore;
    @Column(name = "last_scale_in_at")
    private Instant lastScaleInAt;

    // FIX-11T: persisted Near-TP Failure Protection state. These fields are position-scoped
    // so a restart cannot forget that a rejection was already armed/confirmed or count the
    // same 1m signal multiple times toward bearish persistence.
    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "near_tp_state", nullable = false, length = 40)
    @Builder.Default
    private NearTpState nearTpState = NearTpState.INACTIVE;
    @Column(name = "near_tp_best_price", precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal nearTpBestPrice;
    @Column(name = "near_tp_bearish_streak", nullable = false)
    private int nearTpBearishStreak;
    @Column(name = "near_tp_last_1m_signal_id")
    private Long nearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId;
    @Column(name = "near_tp_harvest_used", nullable = false)
    private boolean nearTpHarvestUsed;
    @Column(name = "near_tp_harvested_quantity", precision = 30, scale = 12)
    private BigDecimal nearTpHarvestedQuantity;
    @Column(nullable = false, length = 20)
    private String status;
    @Column(name = "opened_at", nullable = false)
    private Instant openedAt;
    @Column(name = "updated_at", nullable = false)
    private Instant updatedAt;

## FINDINGS

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** Scope remains exactly frozen `paper_position` IDs `104, 101, 96, 91, 82, 78`. No substitutions.
- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** `db/CODEX/` contains no executed DB results. Entry quality for every selected loss is therefore **unverifiable**, not weak or defective.
- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** Current source links each paper position to its entry signal and records entry decision/risk/context fields in `trade_signal`. Initial BUY execution is intended to require a fresh canonical price, revalidate price against stop/target, then re-score entry quality at that execution price. [PaperPosition.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/domain/PaperPosition.java:12) [PaperTradingService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/service/PaperTradingService.java:257)
- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** The entry-quality model scores expansion from a time-bounded opportunity base, ATR extension, risk/reward, opportunity age, rejection-zone proximity, volatility, and stop exposure. Scores below 50 block an initial chase; remaining scores may cap allocation. [ExecutionIntelligenceService.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/execution/service/ExecutionIntelligenceService.java:865)
- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** A paper position may have progressive adds: its quantity and average entry price can be changed after the initial entry while retaining the original `signal_id`. Therefore, the final `paper_position.entry_price`, quantity, and current managed-position entry-quality score must not be assumed to represent the initial entry alone. Every BUY ledger row during the position lifetime is required.
- **AGENT INFERENCE:** A loss could be attributable to the initial entry, a later scale-in, or neither. The evidence currently cannot distinguish these cases.
- **EXTERNAL RESEARCH:** None.

## EVIDENCE

- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** The current `trade_signal` model holds decision, final-entry permission, score/confidence, strategy, risk/reward, ATR, BTC context/freshness, liquidity, derivatives, regime, candle time, and data-quality fields. [TradeSignal.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/domain/TradeSignal.java:15)
- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** The wallet ledger records decision price separately from execution price and its UTC observation time, allowing actual entry slippage/price movement to be measured when records are supplied. [WalletTrade.java](/C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/wallet/domain/WalletTrade.java:14)
- **PROJECT EVIDENCE:** The supplied metadata has a two-second conversion conflict: `2026-10-11 07:00:03 UTC` converts to `2026-10-11 10:00:03 KSA`, not the stated `10:00:01 KSA`. This does not alter the frozen selection.

### DB_REQUEST
QueryId: DBQ-CODEX-I5-002  
Purpose: Retrieve bounded contemporaneous entry evidence for exactly the frozen positions, including initial signal quality and every linked BUY execution. All returned timestamps are UTC and must be converted to KSA by adding three hours in reporting.  
SQL:
```sql
SELECT
    p.id AS paper_position_id,
    p.symbol,
    p.signal_id AS entry_signal_id,
    p.opened_at,
    p.closed_at,
    p.entry_price,
    p.quantity,
    p.stop_loss,
    p.take_profit,
    p.realized_pnl,
    s.candle_open_time,
    s.generated_at AS signal_generated_at,
    s.interval_code,
    s.decision,
    s.original_decision,
    s.final_entry_allowed,
    s.primary_blocking_stage,
    s.total_score,
    s.confidence_score,
    s.raw_confidence_score,
    s.effective_confidence_score,
    s.latest_price AS decision_price,
    s.stop_loss AS signal_stop_loss,
    s.take_profit AS signal_take_profit,
    s.risk_reward_ratio,
    s.atr_at_signal,
    s.atr_percent,
    s.atr_overextended,
    s.atr_immediate_entry_allowed,
    s.market_regime,
    s.selected_strategy,
    s.strategy_version,
    s.strategy_entry_allowed,
    s.btc_context_status,
    s.btc_context_entry_allowed,
    s.btc_context_candle_close_time,
    s.btc_context_age_seconds,
    s.btc_context_freshness_threshold_seconds,
    s.derivatives_status,
    s.derivatives_entry_allowed,
    s.liquidity_status,
    s.liquidity_entry_allowed,
    s.order_book_target_blocked,
    s.order_book_stop_exposed,
    s.data_quality_valid,
    s.signal_mode,
    s.entry_authority,
    s.entry_authority_max_position_percent,
    p.entry_reason,
    s.final_decision_explanation
FROM crypto_ai.paper_position AS p
JOIN crypto_ai.trade_signal AS s
  ON s.id = p.signal_id
WHERE p.id IN (104, 101, 96, 91, 82, 78)
ORDER BY FIELD(p.id, 104, 101, 96, 91, 82, 78);

SELECT
    p.id AS paper_position_id,
    p.symbol,
    p.signal_id AS original_entry_signal_id,
    p.opened_at,
    p.closed_at,
    wt.id AS wallet_trade_id,
    wt.signal_id AS wallet_signal_id,
    wt.side,
    wt.status,
    wt.execution_type,
    wt.execution_reason,
    wt.executed_at,
    wt.execution_price_observed_at,
    wt.decision_price_usdt,
    wt.price_usdt,
    wt.quantity,
    wt.gross_amount_usdt,
    wt.fee_usdt,
    wt.net_amount_usdt,
    wt.execution_message
FROM crypto_ai.paper_position AS p
LEFT JOIN crypto_ai.wallet_trade AS wt
  ON wt.symbol = p.symbol
 AND wt.side = 'BUY'
 AND wt.status = 'EXECUTED'
 AND wt.executed_at >= p.opened_at - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
 AND wt.executed_at <= p.closed_at
WHERE p.id IN (104, 101, 96, 91, 82, 78)
ORDER BY p.id, wt.executed_at;
```
